rules.label: Environment schema version
rules.rationale: Promotion compares one contract generation only.

rules.label: Environment contract version
rules.rationale: Production must implement the certified v1 contract.

rules.label: Environment name
rules.rationale: Production must not identify as staging.

rules.label: Environment class
rules.rationale: Production must use the Production class after provisioning.

rules.label: Governed lifecycle
rules.rationale: A certifiable Production environment must be governed, not ad hoc.

rules.label: Application framework
rules.rationale: Promotion preserves the application runtime architecture.

rules.label: Application Node major
rules.rationale: Runtime major must match certified staging.

rules.label: Package manager contract
rules.rationale: Reproducible dependency installation must match.

rules.label: Database schema lineage
rules.rationale: Production migrations must come from the same repository lineage.

rules.label: Vercel team identity
rules.rationale: The approved AJ Digital Vercel ownership boundary is preserved.

rules.label: Vercel project ID
rules.rationale: Production must use an independent Vercel project.

rules.label: Vercel project name
rules.rationale: Production project naming must not reuse the staging target.

rules.label: Vercel Node major
rules.rationale: Build/runtime Node posture must match.

rules.label: Vercel custom environment ID
rules.rationale: Production cannot reuse the governed staging environment.

rules.label: Vercel custom environment slug
rules.rationale: The target must be explicitly Production-scoped.

rules.label: Vercel environment type
rules.rationale: The Production target cannot remain a preview-class environment.

rules.label: Manual deployment mode
rules.rationale: Production deployment remains explicitly dispatched.

rules.label: Automatic Git deployment disabled
rules.rationale: Automatic Git deployment stays disabled until governance supersedes v1.

rules.label: Manual-only deployment requirement
rules.rationale: Promotion and deploy remain separate approvals.

rules.label: Deployment Protection requirement
rules.rationale: Protected readback and smoke remain required.

rules.label: Production alias policy
rules.rationale: No Production alias is activated without human approval.

rules.label: Production domain policy
rules.rationale: No Production domain is activated without human approval.

rules.label: Database provider architecture
rules.rationale: The certified Standard-lane Postgres architecture is preserved.

rules.label: Neon project ID
rules.rationale: Production must have an independent Neon project.

rules.label: Neon project name
rules.rationale: Production resource naming must not reuse staging.

rules.label: Neon branch ID
rules.rationale: Production branch identity must be independent.

rules.label: Neon primary branch naming
rules.rationale: The main-branch semantic is preserved inside the independent project.

rules.label: Neon endpoint ID
rules.rationale: Production runtime cannot share the staging endpoint.

rules.label: Database logical name
rules.rationale: The logical database contract is preserved within independent resources.

rules.label: Pooled runtime connection mode
rules.rationale: Runtime connections remain pooled.

rules.label: Direct migration connection mode
rules.rationale: Migrations remain on the direct endpoint.

rules.label: Pooled/direct separation
rules.rationale: Runtime and migration credentials remain separate.

rules.label: Migration-before-application policy
rules.rationale: Production deploy preserves the fail-closed migration sequence.

rules.label: Authentication provider
rules.rationale: The Standard-lane auth architecture is preserved.

rules.label: Authentication-required semantics
rules.rationale: Hosted Production must fail closed.

rules.label: Clerk provider class
rules.rationale: Production must use a Clerk Production instance, not development.

rules.label: Clerk credential class
rules.rationale: Production cannot use test credentials.

rules.label: Required authentication variable names
rules.rationale: Required binding semantics remain identical even though values differ.

rules.label: Authentication fail-closed behavior
rules.rationale: No privileged development fallback is allowed.

rules.label: Exact-SHA enforcement
rules.rationale: Every deploy is bound to an exact reviewed commit.

rules.label: Separate control and application SHA
rules.rationale: Workflow controls and application artifacts retain separate identities.

rules.label: Production workflow-control SHA selection
rules.rationale: The exact Production control SHA is selected at promotion time.

rules.label: Production application SHA selection
rules.rationale: The exact reviewed Production application SHA is separately approved.

rules.label: Production concurrency group
rules.rationale: Production operations must not share staging's lock identity.

rules.label: Non-cancelling concurrency
rules.rationale: Certification and deployment cannot cancel one another.

rules.label: Promotion sequence
rules.rationale: Production is created from contract, plan, readback, diff, certification, and approval.

rules.label: Health check requirement
rules.rationale: Health evidence remains mandatory.

rules.label: Health check path
rules.rationale: Environment identity is verified through the canonical health endpoint.

rules.label: Post-deployment identity validation
rules.rationale: Production must prove the deployed identity after creation.

rules.label: Post-deployment identity fields
rules.rationale: Project, environment, SHA, readiness, and alias state remain auditable.

rules.label: Rollback policy
rules.rationale: Rollback redeploys a known-good artifact and never auto-reverts schema.

rules.label: Configuration certification mechanism
rules.rationale: Production cannot deploy without configuration certification.

rules.label: Production provider execution posture
rules.rationale: Live-gated posture is activated only through provider-specific approval.

rules.label: Provider activation-gate architecture
rules.rationale: No credential alone may activate a provider.

rules.label: Production provider credential allowance
rules.rationale: Environment-specific credentials are installed only after approval.

rules.label: Enabled Production providers
rules.rationale: Each enabled provider requires a named activation decision.

rules.label: Live provider execution approval
rules.rationale: Live execution remains pending until a human gate clears.

rules.label: Secret values forbidden in Git
rules.rationale: No promotion artifact may contain secret values.

rules.label: Production domain activation
rules.rationale: Domain activation changes public routing.

rules.label: Provider enablement
rules.rationale: Provider execution is a separately authorized gate.

rules.label: Telnyx activation
rules.rationale: Telephony activation can create traffic and spend.

rules.label: HubSpot live writes
rules.rationale: CRM writes mutate an external system.

rules.label: Production phone assignment
rules.rationale: Phone routing must not be inferred from staging.

rules.label: Recording enablement
rules.rationale: Recording changes consent, retention, and compliance posture.

rules.label: Public demo exposure
rules.rationale: Public access requires abuse and disclosure controls.

rules.label: Prospect exposure
rules.rationale: Prospect traffic requires a separate go/no-go.

rules.label: Customer tenant activation
rules.rationale: A certified environment alone cannot activate a customer.

rules.label: Retention-policy change
rules.rationale: Retention changes require explicit compliance review.

rules.label: Production promotion
rules.rationale: Contract readiness does not itself authorize promotion.

rules.label: Live-provider execution
rules.rationale: Live-provider execution remains a separate gate.
